resources.string: Lets Jarvis read the Hearthpane screen you are on, point at its controls and control your home through the Control Center.

[{\"name\":\"hearthpane.screen_context\",\"description\":\"Describe the Hearthpane screen in front of the user as structured text (Control Center rooms and devices, Music now playing with its play controls and queue, the Settings page and its rows, Calls rooms with their Video call buttons). No pixels or photos. Call it when the user asks what is on their screen or how to do something on it. Results carry target ids for hearthpane.highlight.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"query\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"For how-do-I questions: a few words of the setting the user wants, e.g. dark mode. Adds the matching Settings rows from anywhere, with where they are.\"}}}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.highlight\",\"description\":\"Pulse one control on the Hearthpane screen in front so the user can see it. Use a target id from hearthpane.screen_context, then tell the user what to do with it.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"target\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"A target id from hearthpane.screen_context, e.g. settings:immortal.settingsTheme, cc.room.kitchen, music.controls or a room\'s video_call_target.\"},\"hint\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"A few words shown beside the control, e.g. Tap the switch.\"}},\"required\":[\"target\"]}},{\"name\":\"hearthpane.home_control\",\"description\":\"Control the user\'s home through Hearthpane\'s Control Center: lights, switches, fans, locks, the garage door, blinds, the water valve, thermostats, the alarm and Home Assistant scenes, by room, floor or device name. Call it for any request to change something in the house, e.g. turn off the kitchen lights, dim the living room to 30 percent, lock the front door, set the heating to 70, run Good night. Locking, lights and the like happen at once. Unlocking, the garage, the water valve, the alarm and some scenes are never done by voice: the result has needs_confirmation and Hearthpane shows its own confirm sheet on the Portal\'s screen, so tell the user to tap it there and do not call again or claim it is done. Answer with the result text, briefly; if it asks which room or device, ask the user.\",\"parameters\":{\"type\":\"OBJECT\",\"properties\":{\"request\":{\"type\":\"STRING\",\"description\":\"The user\'s request in their own words, e.g. turn off the kitchen lights.\"}},\"required\":[\"request\"]}}]
